intro: An action is a method of a regular service in your extension. With the default `Configuration/Services.yaml` of an extension, nothing needs to be registered: the attribute is picked up automatically.

steps.title: Add the attribute
steps.text: Mark a public method with `#[AsAction]`, give it a name and pick an existing scope such as `content:read`.

steps.title: Type input and output
steps.text: Typed parameters and a precise PHPDoc return type become the JSON Schema. Values are validated and converted for you.

steps.title: Declare errors
steps.text: Throw `NotFoundError` or `PermissionDeniedError` and declare each one with `@throws`.

results_intro: That is all. Without further code, both methods are available:

results.value: Both operations with parameters, response schemas and the documented `404`
`fetch_my_extension_news_latest` and `fetch_my_extension_news_by_uid`, for every client that holds `content:read`
`limit` must be an integer, results must match the declared array shapes

scope.title: Optional: a scope of your own
scope.text: The scopes shipped with TYPO3 cover most cases. If an app should be able to get access to your actions separately, register a scope and reference its class in `scopes`.
